```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && node -e "
const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');
const dir='content/english/blog';
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(x=>x.startsWith('__')&&x.endsWith('.md'))) {
  const p=path.join(dir,f);
  const t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');
  const body=t.replace(/^---[\s\S]*?---\n?/,'').trim();
  const words=body.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  const issues=[];
  if(words<80) issues.push('under80:'+words);
  if(/Expanded from|Idea captured from ideas\.jorap\.com/.test(body)) issues.push('wiki-footer');
  if(/image-template\.jpg/.test(t)) issues.push('placeholder-image');
  if(/\busers should\b|it is recommended/i.test(body)) issues.push('third-person');
  if(/^## Bottom line/m.test(body)) issues.push('bottom-line');
  if(issues.length) console.log(f+': '+issues.join(', '));
}
"
```
